purpose: Index packet templates for full module execution while preserving the thin canonical orchestration packet as the default handoff shape.

use_policy.default: Do not load every template. Preserve the canonical packet fields first, then load a module template only when full execution or durable artifact emission needs the module's richer shape.
use_policy.probe_mode: Use CognitiveTools_ProbeProfiles_v1.json and minimal_outputs instead of full packet templates.
use_policy.full_mode: Use the relevant PacketTemplate file as an example output skeleton, then normalize its products back into the canonical packet vocabulary before handoff.
use_policy.compatibility_rule: Fields named regime_profile, dynamical_profile, coupling_packet, transform_plan, branch_set, crem_packet, path_packet, exec_trace, hidden_state_watch, fail_safe_report, and runtime_parameters are canonical orchestration keys.

KCE.use_when: Full anchor extraction, split-layer seed extraction, or durable anchor audit is needed.

DynamicalPrism.use_when: Full reduced-core operator-vector projection or computed-label decomposition is needed.

RegimeField.use_when: Regime confidence, alternate regimes, mismatch watchpoints, or constraint fields materially affect the route.

PrismCoupler.use_when: Actor-role-regime binding, alternate coupling packets, or CREM/ETE/PSPP handoff hints are needed.

CTR.use_when: Transform-family/operator selection needs execution order, return-path requirements, or routing hints.

ETE.use_when: Bounded exploration, operator/regime projection, rejected-branch artifacts, or candidate branches are needed.

CREM.use_when: Relationship rebase, operator/regime conflict separation, dependency invariants, or rebase vectors are needed.
